title: Registry Rewards Benefit Schedule — Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry
content:
Registry rewards of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry are earned for the registrant on guests' purchases from the registry and paid out as a Registry Reward Card. The benefit figures differ by registry type as follows.

| Registry type | Registry rewards percent | Net guest purchases required for any payout (USD) | Maximum rewards paid out per registry (USD) | Payout date, calendar days after the event date |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Celebration Registry | 0 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Graduation Registry | 0 | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable |
| Housewarming Registry | 5 | 250.00 | 250.00 | 45 |
| Baby Registry | 5 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 45 |
| Anniversary Registry | 5 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 45 |
| Wedding Registry | 10 | 500.00 | 1500.00 | 60 |

**Terms common to every registry type**

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Guest purchases that earn no registry rewards | gift cards and sales tax |
| Form of the payout | a Registry Reward Card |
| Rewards on a gift returned before the payout | reversed |
| Registry statuses in which the payout is made | completion and closed |

**Points of reading**

- A registry rewards percent of 0 means the type earns no registry rewards at all; the minimum, cap and payout date then have no application, which is why they read "not applicable" for the Celebration Registry and the Graduation Registry.
- The minimum and the maximum are amounts per registry.
- *Illustration (hypothetical):* on a Wedding Registry, net guest purchases of USD 480.00 are below the USD 500.00 needed for any payout, while USD 520.00 meet it.
